bad_to_the_bone.name: Bad to the Bone
bad_to_the_bone.quote: Listen, I'm no hero. I do not care.
bad_to_the_bone.blurb: A dangerous, arrogant troublemaker who may still choose to do the right thing.

cheater.name: Cheater
cheater.quote: I swear. I have never seen this man in my life!
cheater.blurb: A practiced liar who makes trusting them a risky decision.

cool_but_distressed.name: Cool but Distressed
cool_but_distressed.blurb: A brooding, troubled mess with an effortless cool.

diehard.name: Diehard
diehard.quote: Do your worst. I can do this all day.
diehard.blurb: A relentless hero who keeps standing up when things get hard.

free_spirit.name: Free Spirit
free_spirit.quote: I go wherever I want and only do what I want to do.
free_spirit.blurb: A rebellious improviser who follows their heart instead of orders.

genius_bruiser.name: Genius Bruiser
genius_bruiser.quote: Let's try to be reasonable. There's no need to resort to violence.
genius_bruiser.blurb: A knowledgeable, muscular paradox who prefers brains before brawn.

good_samaritan.name: Good Samaritan
good_samaritan.quote: It was the right thing to do. Anyone would have done the same.
good_samaritan.blurb: A helper who treats every opportunity to protect others as obvious.

hot_stuff.name: Hot Stuff
hot_stuff.quote: Close your eyes. I have a surprise you're going to love.
hot_stuff.blurb: An irresistibly stylish and charming person who turns heads everywhere.

hunk.name: Hunk
hunk.quote: Step away from the door. I'll take care of this.
hunk.blurb: A big, athletic hero who may be intimidating or a gentle giant.

jerk_with_a_heart_of_gold.name: Jerk with a Heart of Gold
jerk_with_a_heart_of_gold.quote: No, I told you, don't even think about it... Don't look at me like that though!
jerk_with_a_heart_of_gold.blurb: An abrasive, overconfident flirt who secretly cares deeply.

last_boy_scout.name: Last Boy Scout / Girl Scout
last_boy_scout.quote: Let me help you, its no trouble at all.
last_boy_scout.blurb: A determined, old-school do-gooder with a positive, slightly naïve attitude.

leader.name: Leader
leader.blurb: A steady, reliable touchstone who leads from the front.

lone_wolf.name: Lone Wolf
lone_wolf.quote: Go to hell! Leave me alone.
lone_wolf.blurb: A rude loner who keeps others at arm's length but can be relied on.

mentor.name: Mentor
mentor.quote: We do not choose the hand we are dealt. But we can choose how to play our cards.
mentor.blurb: A parent-figure who knows how to comfort, move, and encourage others.

neurotic_geek.name: Neurotic Geek
neurotic_geek.quote: That's not how this works, dammit. I've told you: it takes time!
neurotic_geek.blurb: A pop-culture and computer expert ready for more action than their room provided.

party_killer.name: Party Killer
party_killer.quote: This time, we do everything by the book. No mistakes.
party_killer.blurb: A cynical, fussy rule-follower who always knows how to ruin the moment.

trusty_sidekick.name: Trusty Sidekick
trusty_sidekick.quote: All set! What would you do without me?
trusty_sidekick.blurb: A devoted wingman who protects one person they value above all else.

vigilante.name: Vigilante
vigilante.quote: This city is sick, and I am the cure.
vigilante.blurb: A self-appointed protector who solves problems beyond the law.
